cases.question: How long do I have to send something back?
cases.answer: You can return most products within 30 days of delivery. The item must be unused and in its original packaging. Opened software, gift cards and custom-built computers cannot be returned unless they are faulty.

cases.question: When will the money show up in my account after I return an item?
cases.answer: Once the returned item reaches our warehouse we inspect it within 3 business days. Approved refunds go back to the original payment method and usually appear within 5 to 7 business days, depending on your bank.

cases.question: Is there a charge if I threw away the box?
cases.answer: Items returned without the original packaging are charged a 15 percent restocking fee. There is no fee for faulty items.

cases.question: Can I swap my laptop for a different model?
cases.answer: Open a repair request from your account. We collect the device by courier free of charge. Most repairs are completed within 10 business days, and we lend you a replacement laptop for repairs that take longer.

cases.question: How do I get a return label?
cases.answer: Sign in to your TechStore account, open Orders, and choose Return item. We email you a prepaid shipping label within one business day. Drop the parcel at any partner courier point.

cases.question: How fast is next day delivery and what is the cutoff time?
cases.answer: Standard delivery takes 3 to 5 business days. Express delivery arrives the next business day when you order before 2 pm.

cases.question: What do you charge for postage?
cases.answer: Standard delivery is free on orders over 50 euros and costs 4.99 euros otherwise. Express delivery costs 12.99 euros on every order.

cases.question: Do you send orders to Switzerland?
cases.answer: We deliver to all European Union countries, Norway and Switzerland. We do not ship to PO boxes or freight forwarders.

cases.question: My package says delivered but I never got it. What now?

labels.phrase: within 14 days of the delivery date

cases.answer: If a parcel arrives damaged, or tracking shows delivered but you have nothing, contact us within 14 days of the delivery date so we can open a claim with the courier.

cases.question: Where can I see where my order is?
cases.answer: A tracking link is emailed as soon as the parcel leaves our warehouse. You can also find it under Orders in your account.

cases.question: How long is a refurbished phone guaranteed for?
cases.answer: Every new device sold by TechStore includes a 2 year warranty against manufacturing defects. Refurbished devices include a 12 month warranty.

cases.question: I dropped my tablet and the display broke. Is that covered?
cases.answer: Accidental damage such as cracked screens and liquid spills is not covered. Neither is normal battery wear, or damage caused by repairs from unauthorised workshops.

cases.question: Can I buy extra cover against accidents, and by when?
cases.answer: TechStore Care adds accidental damage cover and extends the warranty to 4 years in total. It must be purchased within 60 days of buying the device.

cases.question: How long does fixing a device take?
cases.answer: Open a repair request from your account. We collect the device by courier free of charge. Most repairs are completed within 10 business days, and we lend you a replacement laptop for repairs that take longer.

cases.question: Will my files be safe when I send my computer for repair?
cases.answer: Back up your data before sending a device in. Storage may be erased during repair and TechStore is not responsible for lost files.

cases.question: Until when can I cancel my reservation without paying?
cases.answer: Flexible rate bookings can be cancelled free of charge until 48 hours before the arrival date. After that, the first night is charged.

cases.question: I booked the cheap prepaid rate. Can I get my money back?

cases.question: How do I move my stay to other dates?
cases.answer: You can change dates or room type in Manage booking on our website, or by calling reception. Changes depend on availability and the price may differ.

cases.question: What happens if I just do not turn up?
cases.answer: I'd rather not guess. A member of our front desk team will follow up with you.

cases.question: How much is held on my card when I arrive?
cases.answer: A security deposit of 100 euros per room is held on your card at check-in and released within 5 working days after check-out.

cases.question: What time can I get into my room?
cases.answer: The indoor pool is open from 7 am to 9 pm. The gym is open around the clock with your room key. Children under 16 must be accompanied by an adult in the pool.

cases.question: When is the morning meal served and what does it cost?
cases.answer: A buffet breakfast is served in the Garden Room from 6.30 am to 10.30 am, and until 11 am at weekends. It costs 18 euros per adult and is free for children under six.

cases.question: Is the swimming pool open late in the evening?
cases.answer: The indoor pool is open from 7 am to 9 pm. The gym is open around the clock with your room key. Children under 16 must be accompanied by an adult in the pool.

cases.question: Is internet included?
cases.answer: Wi-Fi is free throughout the hotel. A faster premium connection for video calls and streaming costs 8 euros per day.

cases.question: How do I get from the airport to the hotel?
cases.answer: A shuttle runs between the hotel and the airport every 30 minutes from 5 am to 11 pm. It costs 6 euros per person each way.

cases.question: Can I bring my dog?

cases.question: Is there somewhere to charge my electric car?
